seoTitle: Add a Logo to Your GoDaddy Website
metaDescription: Upload and position your brand logo on a GoDaddy website using the latest Website Builder interface, and fix common blurry logo issues.
intro: Adding a logo is one of the first branding steps for a new GoDaddy website, whether you're starting fresh or updating an existing site. This guide covers uploading your logo file, adjusting its size and alignment, and fixing common display issues like blurriness.

steps.heading: Access the header section
steps.body: Open the header section of your GoDaddy Website Builder, which is where the logo upload option is typically found.

steps.heading: Upload your logo file
steps.body: Upload a high-quality PNG or SVG file of your logo so it displays clearly across the site.

steps.heading: Adjust size and alignment
steps.body: Resize and align the logo within the header so it fits naturally alongside your site's navigation and branding.

steps.heading: Preview on desktop and mobile
steps.body: Check how the logo appears on both desktop and mobile views to confirm it looks correct across devices.

steps.heading: Fix common blurry logo issues
steps.body: If the logo appears blurry, try uploading a higher-resolution file or switching to an SVG format for sharper display.

faq.question: What file format works best for a logo on GoDaddy?
faq.answer: High-quality PNG or SVG files tend to work best, with SVG offering the sharpest display across different screen sizes.

faq.question: Why does my logo look blurry after uploading?
faq.answer: This is usually caused by uploading a low-resolution image, so switching to a higher-resolution file or an SVG can fix it.

faq.question: Can I reposition my logo after it's uploaded?
faq.answer: Yes, the header section allows you to adjust size and alignment even after the logo has already been uploaded.

faq.question: Will my logo automatically resize for mobile visitors?
faq.answer: The Website Builder generally adapts the header for mobile, but it's worth previewing to confirm the logo still looks correct at smaller sizes.
